notes.title: Bubble Ghost Remake 2.0: New Story Mode, Shield System & Balance Tweaks
notes.content:
Thank you for continuing to play Bubble Ghost Remake. This update marks a big step forward in accessibility and overall game balance, offering more ways for every player to enjoy the experience at their own pace.

[h2][b]✨ Major New Features[/b][/h2]

[b]New Difficulty Mode: Story[/b]
A new mode designed for those who want to focus on the puzzles and story without worrying about demanding challenges.

[b]Bubble Shield System[/b]
The bubble can now be fragile, sturdy, or reinforced, depending on your chosen difficulty or personal preference. Customize your experience to match your playstyle.

[b]Change Difficulty and Shield Anytime[/b]
You can now adjust both from the save slot selection menu, without losing progress.

[h2][b]🛠️ Improvements[/b][/h2]

[b]Level Design Adjustments[/b]
Certain difficulty spikes have been smoothed out to ensure a fairer and more consistent progression.

[b]Improved Difficulty Communication[/b]
Revised difficulty descriptions and UI presentation to better reflect the challenge level of each mode.

[h2][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
- Fixed a bug that could cause issues when switching between certain difficulty modes.
- General stability improvements and minor bug fixes.

Thanks as always for your feedback and support.
We love watching you blow your way through every corner of the Bubble Ghost Remake world!

— The Nakama Game Studio Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091890/bee17f0c65cf01a8d7eecb612366aadec51193ba.png[/img]

notes.title: Bubble Ghost Remake – Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Thank you for continuing to play Bubble Ghost Remake. This new update includes several gameplay improvements and bug fixes to further polish the experience.

Improvements

- You can now change the difficulty at any time
  Switch between modes without restarting your run.

- Some difficulty spikes have been balanced
  Adjustments made to specific levels for smoother progression.

Fixes

- The mouse pointer now hides when playing with keyboard and mouse
  A small but helpful tweak to keep the screen clean while playing.

- AZERTY keyboards are now properly supported
  Full compatibility with AZERTY key layouts.

- Minor bugs fixed

Thanks again for all your feedback. We’re continuing to improve the game!

– The Nakama Game Studio Team

notes.title: 👻 Bubble Ghost Remake – Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing Bubble Ghost Remake![/h3]
[i]We've been listening to your feedback, and this patch focuses on improving accessibility, adding new audio content, and polishing key areas to make the experience smoother and more enjoyable.[/i]

[h2]🆕 Highlights:[/h2]

[b]• Checkpoints added in Normal difficulty[/b]
You can now resume progress from mid-level checkpoints, reducing frustration without removing the challenge.

[b]• "Accessible" mode is now called "Easy"[/b]
A clearer name for a mode designed for players who want a more relaxed experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091890/e0780c93852712064c66aab9202f4eb96806642f.png[/img]

[b]• Hard mode is now unlocked from the beginning[/b]
No need to beat the game first — players looking for the toughest challenge can dive right in from the start.

[b]• Level balancing for better accessibility[/b]
We’ve tweaked certain levels to reduce difficulty spikes that were causing unnecessary roadblocks.

[b]• New music tracks added to levels[/b]
We've expanded the soundtrack to better accompany your ghostly adventure. More variety, more immersion!

[b]• Heinrich now whistles over 150 well-known tunes when bored[/b]
Stop moving for a bit and listen closely… our ghost has quite the repertoire!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091890/2034eda06ea69aa83706bea5ed21c25172e5ab4f.png[/img]

[h2]🐞 Fixes:[/h2]

– Fixed a bug that caused a cinematic to end prematurely.
– Fixed an issue that prevented collectibles from being picked up after completing a Madness level.

notes.title: Bubble Ghost Remake is out now! 👻
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Bubble Ghost Remake is out now! 👻💨[/h1]

[h2]The little ghost that stole our hearts is back — more charming than ever[/h2]

The classic is back! Bubble Ghost Remake is now available on [b]Steam[/b], [b]PlayStation 5[/b], [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], and [b]Epic Games Store[/b].

If you played it back in the day on your [i]Atari ST[/i] or [i]Game Boy[/i], get ready for a magical trip down memory lane. And if this is your first time meeting this little bubble-blowing ghost… welcome! You’re in for a delicate and delightful adventure.

[h2]👻 Who is Bubble Ghost?[/h2]

He's the ghost of an inventor... who just can't stop blowing.

Your mission: guide his fragile bubble through a mysterious mansion filled with traps, drafts, and surprises — without letting it pop.

It's peaceful, precise, and surprisingly emotional.

[h2]🎮 What’s waiting for you inside:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Smooth and precise controls to gently blow the bubble through each room
[*] Hand-drawn art full of charm and personality
[*] Classic levels reimagined for the perfect modern-retro balance
[*] A calm, atmospheric soundtrack to float along with
[*] A sweet, satisfying journey whether you're a returning fan or a curious newcomer
[/list]

notes.title: What is Bubble Ghost Remake about?
notes.content:
Guide a little ghost and its bubble through an [b]enchanted mansion filled with dangers and thrilling challenges[/b] in this incredible [u]remake[/u] of Bubble Ghost. Overcome skill levels and clever puzzles while uncovering the hidden story behind the spirit of Heinrich Von Schinker. [b]This reimagined edition of the game[/b] features completely renewed artwork and a plethora of new features [u](such as new game modes, fierce end bosses, collectibles, and many more surprises)[/u] that will keep you hooked for hours. Get ready to blow the bubble through the rooms of this mysterious castle... Will you discover all the secrets it holds?

[h3]Introducing an Extended Trailer[/h3]

[previewyoutube=UgTJ0AzDCKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Bubble Ghost Remake offers an exciting gameplay experience with multiple modes:

[b]Story Mode[/b]
Complete all levels of the game in story mode, including hidden levels and end bosses, while uncovering the secrets behind Heinrich's spirit and his bubble. If you want to fully complete it, you'll have to unlock all abilities and discover all the secrets in each level.

[b]Speedrun Mode[/b]
Enjoy the classic mode where the objective is to finish the game in the shortest time possible, using any strategy to shave off seconds from the timer.

[b]No-Hit Mode[/b]
Will you be able to finish the game without the bubble bursting? Do it, and you'll be welcomed into the growing community of "no-hitters."

[b]Hall of Fame[/b]
Top the leaderboard in each level of the game to become a Bubble Ghost Remake legend.

It will also be available for Nintendo Switch.
